verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's Warehouse Connectors sync data from Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift and Postgres into Mixpanel. A Mirror mode uses Snowflake Streams and Databricks Change Data Feed to keep that sync current, which covers the warehouse-to-product direction of the story. The reverse direction relies on the Raw Event Export API, which returns JSONL for high-volume pulls, so continuous delivery into a warehouse would need a pipeline you build yourself. Missing for 10: a native continuous export or pipeline from Mixpanel into a warehouse, true in-place querying of warehouse tables rather than syncing them in, and independent hands-on corroboration of the connectors.
